description: This file defines the MistralEmbedding_Embeddings class implementing the INode interface, which integrates MistralAI embeddings into a larger system. It includes methods for initializing the embedding model with credentials and parameters, and loads model options dynamically.

classes.name: MistralEmbedding_Embeddings
classes.description: A class implementing INode to provide MistralAI embedding functionalities, including configuration, model loading, and initialization with credentials.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains the asynchronous method listModels to fetch available model options for embeddings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the MistralAI embedding model with parameters and credentials extracted from nodeData and options.
